name: tesla
description: Connect Cursor, Grok Bot, and Grok Build to a self-hosted Tesla Fleet MCP over Streamable HTTP. Skills for status reads and confirmed vehicle commands.

TESLA_MCP_URL.title: Tesla MCP URL
TESLA_MCP_URL.description: Public HTTPS Streamable HTTP endpoint, including /mcp. Not localhost. Example: https://mcp.example.com/mcp

TESLA_MCP_TOKEN.title: Tesla MCP token
TESLA_MCP_TOKEN.description: Bearer token sent as Authorization on the HTTP MCP. Not a Tesla Fleet or Tessie token.
